description: CLMS Non-Vegetated Land Cover Characteristics product filename per the CLMS Filenaming Framework (extension optional).

theme.description: Product code (HR prefix dropped per CLMS Framework convention)

variable.description: Layer code hyphen-appended to the product code (e.g., IMCCS, IMD, IBUC, SBCC)

temporal_coverage.description: Temporal coverage token where CYYYY-YYYY captures change layers and SYYYY captures status layers

tile_id.title: INSPIRE ETRS89-LAEA Grid
tile_id.description: Regional LAEA grid tile identifier (2- or 3-digit coordinates)

epsg_code.description: Bare EPSG code of the product grid, no zero-padding (e.g., 3035)

version_revision.description: Single hyphenated version+revision token (R = Revision, not Release)
